The ShED Forum (Shershahbadi Educational Dialogue Forum) is a community-led grassroots educational foundation established in 2018 to bridge the divide between rural Seemanchal and India’s premier central universities.

From remote villages across Katihar, Purnea, Araria, Kishanganj, Malda, Murshidabad, and Sahibganj to the historic gates of Jamia Millia Islamia, AMU, MANUU, DU, JNU, and HCU, our journey has been one of continuous on-ground mobilization—replacing educational hesitation with institutional access and academic excellence.

We support over 1,000+ rural scholars annually through 100% free CUET entrance coaching, station reception, document verification, verified hostel navigation, and dedicated one-to-one peer adoption by senior research fellows.

“Every household in the Shershahbadi community should have access to higher education and the opportunities it creates.”

— Founding Principle • The ShED Forum

2026 & Beyond
2018
The Initial Spark & Founding at MANUU

When a handful of first-generation Shershahbadi scholars arrived at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) in Hyderabad, they realized representation from their region was severely limited due to lack of exposure and missing admission guidance.

Founded intentionally on March 8th (International Women's Day) to place female higher education at the center of the movement.
•
Established the unwritten covenant: Every admitted scholar commits to guiding and mentoring the next junior cohort.
•
2019 – 2020
Grassroots Seemanchal Ground Outreach

Scholars returned to their home villages across Seemanchal during summer and winter vacations to mobilize families, counsel hesitant parents, and dispel long-standing misconceptions about university education.

•
Village-to-village assemblies in Katihar, Purnea, Araria, Kishanganj, Malda, Murshidabad, and Sahibganj.
•
Overcoming parental doubts regarding sending daughters to metropolitan university hostels.
2021
SCG Centre & Jamia Millia Islamia Expansion

Formal establishment of the Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) Unit in New Delhi and inauguration of the SCG Centre (Shershahbadi Guidance & Coaching) to deliver structured, 100% free entrance exam preparation.

Free daily coaching, printed study modules, and NTA-pattern mock tests for CUET and central university tests.
•
Over 450+ successful admissions secured in central universities through free coaching.
•
2022
AMU Aligarh Unit & Soft Skills Revolution

Expansion to Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), building a powerhouse unit of 220+ scholars and launching an intensive 6-Month Spoken English & Soft Skills Bootcamp to break language barriers.

•
Empowered vernacular-medium rural students to excel in English-medium university seminar halls.
•
Introduced weekly public speaking, debate circles, and digital literacy masterclasses.
2023
Nationwide Central University Footprint

Expansion across Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), Delhi University (DU), University of Hyderabad (HCU), and Patna University, establishing seasonal admission booths at campus gates and verified hostel aid.

Active help-desks assisting rural applicants with preference filling, cut-offs, and affidavits.
•
Peer adoption system ensuring zero loneliness or imposter syndrome for first-generation newcomers.
•
2024 – 2025
1,000+ Alumni Network & Central Placement Cell

The ShED Alumni network surpassed 1,000+ working professionals in civil services (UPSC/BPSC), multinational corporations, judiciary, academia, and banking, launching the Central Placement Cell.

•
Direct internship pipelines, civil service mentoring circles, and NET-JRF guidance.
•
Emergency student grant pool ensuring zero capable scholars drop out due to financial hardship.
2026 & Beyond
Sustainable Community Transformation

Today, The ShED Forum stands as a recognized benchmark of self-reliant community empowerment, achieving 38%+ female higher education representation and expanding digital learning access to thousands of rural households.

Permanent community learning libraries and digital coaching infrastructure across Seemanchal.
•
Every generation lifting the next into the highest corridors of education and governance.

"Rigorous 100% free CUET coaching with zero compromise on quality."

CLASS 12TH GRADUATES & UNDERGRADUATE ASPIRANTS
02 / 08
SCG Centre Entrance Prep

Provides 100% free comprehensive coaching, printed study modules, daily practice papers, and expert guest lectures for rural youth aspiring to enter premier central universities including Jamia Millia Islamia, AMU, MANUU, DU, JNU, HCU, and Patna University.

KEY DELIVERABLES & SUPPORT MECHANISM:
Daily structured classes covering General Test, Domain Subjects & Languages
NTA pattern computer-based mock tests with detailed performance analysis
Free distribution of standard reference books and curated notes
Special weekend masterclasses by research scholars and university professors
